label.zh: 图匠 · 电商视觉设计师

description.zh: 电商做图助手「图匠」— 把商品实拍图变成可直接上架的主图与场景图。支持白底主图、场景换背景、模特手持、细节卖点图、套装组合，一次出多张供挑选；内置平台规格与风格模板库，并强制遵守「商品必须保真」红线（颜色、材质、logo、结构不得改变）。
description.en: E-commerce visual assistant 'Pic' — turns product photos into shelf-ready main images and lifestyle scenes. White-background hero shots, background swaps, model shots, detail/feature close-ups, and multi-item sets; multiple variants per run, with platform specs and a style template library. Enforces product fidelity (color, material, logo, structure must not change).

welcome_message.zh: 发一张商品图给我，说清场景和用途，我出几版主图给你挑
welcome_message.en: Send me a product photo with the scene and purpose, and I'll generate a few main-image variants to pick from

description.zh: 纯白底棚拍，平台审核最稳
description.en: Studio white background — safest for platform review

prompt.zh:
请把这张商品图做成白底主图，1:1，出 4 张。商品颜色、材质、logo 和结构必须完全不变。

商品图：
prompt.en:
Turn this product photo into a white-background main image, 1:1, 4 variants. Product color, material, logo, and structure must stay exactly the same.

Product photo:

description.zh: 保留商品，换背景与氛围光
description.en: Keep the product, change background and lighting

prompt.zh:
请保留这张商品图中的商品完全不变，只更换场景与光线。想要的感觉是：___（如夏日户外/居家暖调/科技冷调），1:1，出 4 张。

商品图：
prompt.en:
Keep the product in this photo exactly as-is; change only the scene and lighting. Desired feel: ___ (e.g. summer outdoor / warm home / cool tech), 1:1, 4 variants.

Product photo:

description.zh: 生活方式构图，人物面部不入镜
description.en: Lifestyle composition, model face out of frame

prompt.zh:
请做一张模特手持/佩戴的种草图，模特面部不入镜或虚化出画，服装为简约中性色不抢主体。商品本身必须完全不变。3:4，出 4 张。

商品图：
prompt.en:
Create a lifestyle shot with a model holding/wearing the product; model's face out of frame or blurred. Neutral clothing that doesn't compete with the product. Product itself must stay exactly the same. 3:4, 4 variants.

Product photo:

description.zh: 放大工艺与材质，强调卖点

prompt.zh:
请做一张细节特写图，聚焦这个商品的 ___（如镜头开孔边缘/缝线走线/材质纹理），极浅景深，凸显材质质感。不要改变商品颜色与结构。1:1，出 4 张。

商品图：
prompt.en:
Create a macro detail shot focused on ___ (e.g. camera cutout edge / stitching / material texture), very shallow depth of field, emphasizing material quality. Do not change the product's color or structure. 1:1, 4 variants.

Product photo:

description.zh: 同一套场景参数套用到多个商品
description.en: Apply one scene preset across many products

prompt.zh:
请用同一套场景与光线，为我这一批商品图统一出主图，保证店铺视觉一致。场景是：___，1:1，每个商品出 2 张，不要加水印。

商品图：
prompt.en:
Using one consistent scene and lighting setup, generate main images for this batch of product photos so the store looks visually uniform. Scene: ___, 1:1, 2 variants each, no watermark.

Product photos:

description.zh: 用做主图的那张图生成展示视频
description.en: Animate the chosen main image into a clip

prompt.zh: 请用刚才选定的那张主图生成一段 5 秒的商品展示短视频，镜头缓慢推近并带轻微环绕，商品保持完全不变。
prompt.en: Turn the chosen main image into a 5-second product showcase video — slow push-in with a slight orbit, product unchanged.

zh: 每周一「10:00」把上周新上的商品图各出一版白底主图，发给我挑
每天「18:00」汇总当天出图记录，列出还没人工复核的商品
每天「09:00」检查有没有出图失败的任务，失败的重试一次并告诉我结果
en: Every Monday at 10:00, generate a white-background main image for each product uploaded last week and send for selection
Every day at 18:00, summarize today's generated images and list products not yet human-reviewed
Every day at 09:00, check for failed image jobs, retry once, and report the outcome
